mapper.select: select oa.id as id, oa.org_id as orgId, oa.dentist_id as dentistId, oa.patient_id as patientId, oa.appoint_item_id as appointItemId, oa.appoint_content as appointContent, date_format(oa.appoint_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as appointDate, oa.appoint_time as appointTime, oa.duration as duration, oa.patient_name as patientName, oa.patient_phone as patientPhone, oa.status as status, date_format(oa.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d') as crtTime, a.id as appointmentId, a.confirm_status as confirmStatus from online_appointment oa inner join appointment a on a.online_appointment_id = oa.id and a.inservice = true where oa.id = #{id} and oa.inservice = true
